title: Sectors and Worker Groups Experiencing Material Effects of 12.5% US Tariff
what_it_is: Sectors and Worker Groups Experiencing Material Effects of 12.5% US Tariff

sections.label: US tariff impact on Singapore
sections.summary: About $9.5 billion of Singapore's domestic exports face a 12.5% US tariff, with support schemes for affected businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: About one-third of Singapore's domestic exports to the US, or around $9.5 billion, are exposed to this 12.5% tariff.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: This is about 3% of our total domestic exports globally.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: In addition to optical instruments and chemical products, the other products in Singapore that are affected by the 12.5% tariff include offshore drilling and production platforms, and precious metals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Furthermore, the additional 2.5% in tariff compared to the earlier 10% tariff imposed under Section 122 is equivalent to an estimated 0.7 percentage point increase in Singapore's overall effective tariff rate with the US.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: We are also actively engaging businesses and the Labour Movement so that we can detect early signs of difficulties faced by businesses and workers if they arise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Thus far, the impact of the US' Section 301 tariff on our economy has been muted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: In October last year, we launched the Business Adaptation Grant (BizAdapt) to support eligible enterprises in redesigning their business operations and strengthening supply chain resilience.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: And at this year's Budget, we also announced higher grant support levels for schemes, such as the Market Readiness Assistance grant, to help our firms diversify and grow in overseas markets.

sections.label: Support for workers beyond redundancies
sections.summary: The government will study whether workers face increased hours or reduced pay and stands ready to support them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang
sentences.text: For his suggestion on whether we are looking at workers beyond just redundancies but also increased working hours or reduced pay, that is something that we will study and if required, we stand ready to support our businesses and our workers.
